meta.cost_policy: The cost_for_two fields are blank where no official fixed meal price or official per-person tasting price was verified. Michelin's $, $$, $$$ and $$$$ are guide price categories, not dollar totals for two. Do not multiply a category into a meal estimate.
meta.hours_policy: Only the complete weekly schedule captured from Restaurant de Joël Robuchon’s official MICHELIN profile on 2026-11-26 is populated. Other hours are blank because search snippets or partial schedules were not strong enough to confirm a complete weekly schedule. The retained hours are a current profile snapshot, not a guarantee for Feb–Mar 2027; recheck the venue before booking.
meta.social_policy: Social/video URLs are included only if verified from an official venue source. Restaurant account URLs were not confirmed in this research snapshot, so entries are blank and flagged rather than guessed.
